hook: Tim Cook joined Apple in 1998 to run its operations and became chief executive in August 2011, succeeding Steve Jobs. He led the company until August 31, 2026, a period in which Apple's market value rose from about $350 billion to $4 trillion, and in June 2024 he introduced Apple Intelligence, the company's generative AI system. Since September 1, 2026, he has been Apple's executive chairman, with John Ternus as chief executive.

quick_facts: Born in Mobile, Alabama, in 1960, he earned an industrial engineering degree from Auburn University and an MBA from Duke University, where he was a Fuqua Scholar.
He spent about twelve years in IBM's personal computer business and worked briefly at Compaq before joining Apple in 1998.
At Apple he was chief operating officer, responsible for worldwide sales and operations, before becoming chief executive in August 2011.
Apple says its annual revenue grew from $108 billion in fiscal 2011 to more than $416 billion in fiscal 2025 under his leadership.
He became executive chairman on September 1, 2026, and Apple's leadership page lists him as Executive Chair.
He serves on the boards of Nike and the National Football Foundation and on Duke University's board of trustees.

achievements.title: Apple Intelligence
achievements.impact: Introduced June 10, 2024, combining models that run on the device with larger models on Apple silicon servers through Private Cloud Compute, plus an optional handoff to ChatGPT.

achievements.title: Growth as chief executive
achievements.impact: Apple's market value rose from about $350 billion to $4 trillion and its services business grew past $100 billion during his time as CEO, according to the company.

achievements.title: New product categories
achievements.impact: Oversaw the launch or expansion of Apple Watch, AirPods and Apple Vision Pro, along with services such as Apple Pay, Apple Music and Apple TV.

achievements.title: Leadership succession
achievements.impact: Handed the chief executive role to John Ternus in a transition the board approved unanimously and announced on April 20, 2026.
